name: Modbus Client → On Not Sent
description: Fires when the frame never reached the wire - for example, an empty PDU, a duplicate write already pending (see [Duplicate suppression](https://esphome.io/components/modbus_client#behavior)), a full send queue, or cancelled by another device or automation clearing the queue for the same address. Distinct from a timeout: nothing was transmitted. Lambda variable: `request` (`std::span<const uint8_t>`, the PDU that was not sent).
